goals: Maintain a private Minecraft Java 26.2 downstream Ribbits build for the fixed Mynx and Matcha stack, preserving upstream behavior except for individually documented intentional Mynx deviations.

Maintain the user-approved tiered Glowcap trade economy, persistent profession progression and daily restocking, exact cross-stack item contracts, and Toadstool Heart home-setting behavior without converting Ribbits into vanilla Villagers.

Maintain the exact Phase C swamp-hut Sorcerer, natural-Witch boundary, shared Ribbit Village explorer-map result, failed-map Sorcerer service, and future-only village utility cleanup without retrofitting existing structures.

Provide one dedicated nonprofession Wandering Ribbit merchant with its own Creative spawn egg, lore-friendly wooded/green/lush automatic habitat policy, four exact compass buybacks, and an independent persistent server scheduler whose exact one-entity lease, bounded loaded-chunk placement, visit lifetime, and fair player selection never reuse or alter vanilla Wandering Trader state.

Provide the unlimited-use ribbits:chute_leaf as a server-authoritative controlled-descent item eligible only for the accepted one-entry chest/cape Trinkets slot, with exact Elytra/glider conflict boundaries and no Elytra flight behavior.

Own the native ribbits:ribbit_village map-decoration identity and exact successful-map presentation while exposing stable optional Wandering trade-provider and Map Marker Extensions boundaries and retaining the ordinary vanilla map contract used by Compass Ribbon.
Keep every private reconstruction deterministic and hash-guarded while isolating protected Ribbits resources and approved local donor visuals from the public source repository.
scope: Retain the legally trackable faithful-port baseline and maintain the intentional deviations recorded in MYNX_DEVIATIONS.md without changing stable mod, registry, entity, or save identities.

Maintain all nine registered Ribbit professions, their typed eggs, the explicit equal-weight eight-member natural village pool, and the separate nonprofession Wandering Ribbit egg with exact Creative, hand, dispenser, pick-block, codec, persistence, model, texture, and umbrella contracts.

Maintain the cumulative profession trade-profile framework, fixed Glowcap prices, persistent specializations and gates, deterministic Chef menus, two-restocks-per-day policy, and exact component-aware Matcha and Custom Portals stack matching introduced by Mynx Canary 3.

Maintain new-hut-only replacement of the initial swamp-hut Witch with one persistent Sorcerer, independent Cat relocation, an exact-piece natural-Witch rejection, one lazy map barrel, and the marker-authenticated rank-independent failed-map redemption introduced by Mynx Canary 4.

Maintain the exact hash-pinned four-template private NBT transform for future Ribbit village placement while preserving the pristine Smoker and Blast Furnace templates byte-for-byte and retaining every non-target record, storage block, loot binding, and processor sentinel.

Maintain ribbits:glowcap and ribbits:toadstool_heart as permanent mechanical identities with their user-approved 16-by-16 RGBA sprites, with the authorized Canary 9 one-pixel-down Glowcap alignment and conventional generated-item models.

Maintain ribbits:wandering_ribbit as a separate 0.5-by-0.75 AbstractVillager with 15 health, approximately 0.125 movement speed, no breeding, profession, home, rank, restock, progress, or permanent automatic residency; preserve command- and egg-created merchants as persistent and scheduler-independent.

Maintain server-global SavedData ribbits:wandering_ribbit_spawner with next attempt time, lease generation, active UUID and dimension, visit expiry, fair-player cursor, and last-observed time; one execution per server tick; cap one; exact unchanged timing; at most 64 loaded-chunk-only site candidates; candidate-feet biome evaluation; the exact 20-biome vanilla baseline; audited family-tag extension; authoritative empty allow tags; missing-tag fallback; and deny precedence.

Maintain stable sorted WanderingRibbitTradeProvider identities, persisted seed/provider/schema/offer ranges and exact serialized offers: native schema 3 preserves offer indexes and all buybacks while pricing newly materialized maps at eight Glowcaps with no compass; optional provider ribbits:optional_matcha_compasses schema 1 atomically adds Copper, Golden, and Titanium buybacks for the exact intended Matcha stack; optional provider ribbits:optional_naturalist_fauna selects two of 19 approved baby fauna eggs and nine approved variant buckets without replacement, only when their registry entries are available, without altering saved merchants.

Maintain scheduler-only Naturalist snail companionship as an optional reflective bridge: exactly two brown tagged snails are created once for an automatically materialized Wandering Ribbit, leashed to it, persisted by UUID, and removed or cleaned up with the lease; command- and egg-created merchants remain companion-free and no Naturalist class is linked by Ribbits.

Maintain ribbits:chute_leaf as a stack-one noncraftable nondurable item using only data/trinkets/tags/item/chest/cape.json, a monotonic physical-jump request and owner acknowledgement protocol, a server-owned pending/deployed state machine, and a narrow terminal-descent cap of -0.10 blocks per tick.

Maintain native map-decoration type ribbits:ribbit_village, exact success custom-data marker ribbits:ribbit_village_explorer_map=true, ordinary filled-map/map-id/decorations synchronization, and user-authored marker cropped without resampling to the native 8-by-8 atlas canvas and successful filled-map item artwork under the Ribbits namespace.

Preserve the private resource assembler; exact pristine, Minecraft, dependency, output, and archive identities; all three existing mod donors; the authoritative Matcha overlay recolor donor; and the authorized shared green ten-egg derivation contract including the Wandering Ribbit egg.

Display Drop Leaf while preserving ribbits:chute_leaf registry/save identity; use the exact latest 16x16 inventory PNG independently from the earlier closed-back sprite through a render-only auxiliary chute_leaf_closed model, derive only the deployed open model from the donor Wandering Ribbit entity's rain-held umbrella_leaf/grip/leaf2 geometry, and expose the exact 128x128 donor entity PNG through an item-atlas-safe Ribbits texture path while preserving renderer attachment, first-person presentation, activation, and movement behavior.

Maintain ribbits:small_brown_toadstool as a distinct small-plant counterpart to ribbits:toadstool with the same placement, shape, ordinary drop and pick-block, default stacking, Creative exposure, and 0.65 compost behavior; a dedicated brown-only bonemeal patch; exact private donor-derived item and block visuals; and no change to the existing small red or huge red/brown toadstool identities and resources.

exclusions: Protected Ribbits resources, donor-derived models and textures, pristine or donor binaries, private manifests and reports, and the complete private Canary JAR are external, ignored, private-use-only, and nonredistributable.
Public source-only build output is resource-incomplete and must not be represented as a runnable Canary.

Canary 13 adds only the optional Naturalist fauna provider and scheduler-only brown-snail companions; it adds no hard Naturalist dependency, Regions Unexplored provider, rescued-baby capsule, pattern, botanical good, or unrelated economy. An unavailable Naturalist entry safely contributes zero offers and no companion.

Canary 8 adds no chest/back assignment or eligibility, Trinkets all-tag, new slot/group definition, vanilla glider or equippable component, Elytra tag, second inventory implementation, Elytra wings renderer, flight, steering, lift, pose, durability, or firework behavior; accepted Inventory Extended, Trinkets, their companion, Traveler Toolbelt, and Elytra-support artifacts remain separate and unchanged.

No Wandering forest camp, donor scheduler/trades/code/AI/sounds/world generation, vanilla Wandering Trader replacement or suppression, trader llama, automatic Sorcerer replacement, existing-hut or village retrofit, saved-Witch conversion, global Witch suppression, asynchronous map search, custom map item or GUI, direct failed-map fallback, generalized old-offer migration, home-dimension redesign, Fortune Blessing, Silver Bullion, or Adamant/Netherite economy additions are introduced.

Ribbits has no dependency on Map Marker Extensions or Compass Ribbon, contributes no custom map HUD or side-channel destination, and does not modify either project; Map Marker Extensions owns only its optional carried-target projection and Compass Ribbon consumes the standard native decoration path.
No substitute private inputs, deployment, Test Instance Manager mutation, gameplay-profile access, or Minecraft runtime claim from source, build, static, codec, tree, or archive evidence.

Canary 25 adds no ordinary natural generation, biome, village, or structure placement, trades, recipes, Toadstool Heart participation, or other economy. Matcha-Overlays-v37.zip contributes only two hash-guarded private visual inputs for ribbits:small_brown_toadstool; it is never bundled and never replaces native ribbits:brown_toadstool resources.
